verdict.rationale: Auto-approval is a fair question for HumanLayer, since it orchestrates agent sessions with human review, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents a setting to auto-approve all agent actions or bypass per-action confirmation. The nearby items cover workflow selection (e.g. Oneshot with fewer review points), non-interactive CI automation sessions, and launch tokens for non-interactive authentication. None of them states that per-action approval prompts can be turned off.
